arcane_subtlety.name: Arcane Subtlety
arcane_subtlety.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by [V1]% and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by [V2]%.

arcane_focus.name: Arcane Focus
arcane_focus.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit by [V1]% and reduces the mana cost of your Arcane spells by [V2]%.

arcane_stability.name: Arcane Stability
arcane_stability.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting or channeling an Arcane spell by [V1]%.

arcane_recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
arcane_recovery.tooltipTemplate: Increases your healing done by [V1]% and increases your mana by [V2]% of your Intellect.

arcane_fortitude.name: Arcane Fortitude
arcane_fortitude.tooltipTemplate: Increases your armor by an amount equal to [V1]% of your Intellect.

magic_absorption.name: Magic Absorption
magic_absorption.tooltipTemplate: Increases all resistances by [V1] per level and causes all spells that damage you have a 10% chance to restore [V2]% of your total mana. 6 second cooldown.

arcane_concentration.name: Arcane Concentration
arcane_concentration.tooltipTemplate:
Gives you a [V1]% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage or healing spell hits a target.  

The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next spell by 100%.

magic_attunement.name: Magic Attunement
magic_attunement.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Arcane damage spells by [V1] yards and the effect of your Amplify Magic and Dampen Magic spells by [V2]%.

spell_impact.name: Spell Impact
spell_impact.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Arcane Explosion, Arcane Blast, Blast Wave, Fire Blast, Scorch, Fireball, Ice Lance and Cone of Cold spells by an additional [V1]%.

arcane_meditation.name: Arcane Meditation
arcane_meditation.tooltipTemplate: Allows [V1]% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.

focus_magic.name: Focus Magic
focus_magic.tooltipTemplate: Increases the target's chance to critically hit with spells by 3%.  When the target critically hits the caster's chance to critically hit with spells is increased by 3% for 10 sec.  Cannot be cast on self.

arcane_shielding.name: Arcane Shielding
arcane_shielding.tooltipTemplate: Decreases the mana lost per point of damage taken when Mana Shield is active by [V1]% and increases the resistances granted by Mage Armor by [V2]%.

improved_counterspell.name: Improved Counterspell
improved_counterspell.tooltipTemplate: Your Counterspell also silences the target for [V1] sec.

arcane_momentum.name: Arcane Momentum
arcane_momentum.tooltipTemplate: Arcane Blast stacks empower Arcane Mending. Arcane Mending consumes an Arcane Blast stack to cast [V1]% faster and gain [V2]% increased chance to critically strike.

torment_the_weak.name: Torment the Weak
torment_the_weak.tooltipTemplate: Your Frostbolt, Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Pyroblast, Arcane Missiles, Arcane Blast, and Arcane Barrage abilities deal [V1]% more damage to snared or slowed targets.

improved_blink.name: Improved Blink
improved_blink.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of Blink by [V1]% and for 4 sec after casting your chance to be hit by all attacks and spells is reduced by [V2]%.

presence_of_mind.name: Presence of Mind
presence_of_mind.tooltipTemplate: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

prismatic_cloak.name: Prismatic Cloak
prismatic_cloak.tooltipTemplate: Reduces all damage taken by [V1]% and reduces the fade time of your Invisibility spell by [V2] sec.

arcane_instability.name: Arcane Instability
arcane_instability.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage, healing and critical strike chance of your spells by [V1]%.

arcane_potency.name: Arcane Potency
arcane_potency.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your next spell by [V1]% after gaining Clearcasting or Presence of Mind.

arcane_attunement.name: Arcane Attunement
arcane_attunement.tooltipTemplate:
Arcane Blast no longer increases damage and mana cost and instead increases your healing done by [V1]% per stack.

Your Arcane Resonance now generates a stack of Arcane Blast every [V2] seconds.

arcane_empowerment.name: Arcane Empowerment
arcane_empowerment.tooltipTemplate:
Increases the effectiveness of your Arcane Missiles, Arcane Blast, Arcane Mending and Arcane Resonance spell by an amount equal to [V1]% of your spell power.

In addition, increases the damage of all party and raid members within 100 yds by [V2]%.

arcane_power.name: Arcane Power
arcane_power.tooltipTemplate: When activated, your spells deal 20% more damage and healing while costing 20% more mana to cast.  This effect lasts 15 sec.

incanters_absorption.name: Incanter's Absorption
incanters_absorption.tooltipTemplate: When your Mana Shield, Frost Ward, Fire Ward, or Arcane Barrier absorbs damage your spell power is increased by [V1]% of the amount absorbed for 10 sec.

arcane_flows.name: Arcane Flows
arcane_flows.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Presence of Mind, Arcane Power and Invisibility spells by [V1]% and the cooldown of your Evocation spell by [V2] min.

mind_mastery.name: Mind Mastery
mind_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Increases spell power by [V1]% of your total Intellect.

slow.name: Slow
slow.tooltipTemplate: Reduces target's movement speed by 60%, increases the time between ranged attacks by 60% and increases casting time by 30%.  Lasts 15 sec.  Slow can only affect one target at a time.

missile_barrage.name: Missile Barrage
missile_barrage.tooltipTemplate:
Gives your Arcane Blast a [V1]% chance, and your Arcane Barrage, Fireball, Frostbolt and Frostfire Bolt spells a [V2]% chance to empower your next Arcane Missiles or Arcane Resonance.

Arcane Missiles: Your missiles now trigger and channel twice as fast.

Arcane Resonance: Empowers Resonance causing it to trigger three times faster, healing nearby injured allies.

spell_power.name: Spell Power
spell_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases critical strike damage bonus of all spells by [V1]%.

arcane_barrage.name: Arcane Barrage
arcane_barrage.tooltipTemplate: Launches several missiles at the enemy target, causing 500 to 609 Arcane damage.

arcane_barrier.name: Arcane Barrier
arcane_barrier.tooltipTemplate:
Consumes your Arcane Blast stacks to instantly heal a friendly target for 463 and surround them with an Arcane barrier for 4 seconds per stack.

The shield absorbs up to 30% of physical damage taken, up to an amount equal to 10% of your max mana. Each point of damage absorbed costs 0.1 mana.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Chill effects a [V1]% chance to freeze the target for 5 sec.

improved_frostbolt.name: Improved Frostbolt
improved_frostbolt.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by [V1] sec.

ice_floes.name: Ice Floes
ice_floes.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Ice Block and Icy Veins spells by [V1]%.

ice_shards.name: Ice Shards
ice_shards.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by [V1]%.

frost_warding.name: Frost Warding
frost_warding.tooltipTemplate: Increases the armor and resistances given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by [V1]%.  In addition, gives your Frost Ward and Fire Ward a [V2]% chance to negate the warded damage spell and restore mana equal to the damage caused.

precision.name: Precision
precision.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost and increases your chance to hit with spells by [V1]%.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.tooltipTemplate: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 3 secs, reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%, and reduces the target's healing received by 20%.

piercing_ice.name: Piercing Ice
piercing_ice.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by [V1]%.

icy_veins.name: Icy Veins
icy_veins.tooltipTemplate: Hastens your spellcasting, increasing spell casting speed by 20% and reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 100%.  Lasts 20 sec.

improved_blizzard.name: Improved Blizzard
improved_blizzard.tooltipTemplate: Adds a chill effect to your Blizzard spell.  This effect lowers the target's movement speed by [V1]%.  Lasts 1.5 sec.

arctic_reach.name: Arctic Reach
arctic_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of all your Frost spells except for Frostfire Bolt, and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by [V1]%.

frost_channeling.name: Frost Channeling
frost_channeling.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of all spells by [V1]% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by [V2]%.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against frozen targets by [V1]%.

cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
cold_snap.tooltipTemplate: When activated, this spell finishes the cooldown on all Frost spells you recently cast.

improved_cone_of_cold.name: Improved Cone of Cold
improved_cone_of_cold.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by [V1]%.

frozen_core.name: Frozen Core
frozen_core.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the damage taken from all spells by [V1]%.

cold_as_ice.name: Cold as Ice
cold_as_ice.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Cold Snap, Ice Barrier and Summon Water Elemental spells by [V1]%.

winters_chill.name: Winter's Chill
winters_chill.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to critically hit with Frostbolt by an additional [V1]% and gives your Frost damage spells a [V2]% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance spells will critically hit the target by 1% for 15 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times.

shattered_barrier.name: Shattered Barrier
shattered_barrier.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Ice Barrier spell a [V1]% chance to freeze all enemies within 10 yds for 8 sec when it is destroyed.

ice_barrier.name: Ice Barrier
ice_barrier.tooltipTemplate: Instantly shields you, absorbing 497 damage.  Lasts 1 min.  While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be delayed by damage.

arctic_winds.name: Arctic Winds
arctic_winds.tooltipTemplate: Increases all Frost damage you cause by [V1]% and reduces the chance melee and ranged attacks will hit you by [V2]%.

empowered_frostbolt.name: Empowered Frostbolt
empowered_frostbolt.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Frostbolt spell by an amount equal to [V1]% of your spell power and reduces the cast time by [V2] sec.

fingers_of_frost.name: Fingers of Frost
fingers_of_frost.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Chill effects a [V1]% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen.  Lasts 15 sec.

brain_freeze.name: Brain Freeze
brain_freeze.tooltipTemplate: Your Frost damage spells with chilling effects have a [V1]% chance to cause your next Fireball or Frostfire Bolt spell to be instant cast and cost no mana.

summon_water_elemental.name: Summon Water Elemental
summon_water_elemental.tooltipTemplate: Summon a Water Elemental to fight for the caster?(s70937)[][ for 45 sec].

enduring_winter.name: Enduring Winter
enduring_winter.tooltipTemplate: Increases the duration of your Summon Water Elemental spell by [V1] sec and your Frostbolt spell has a [V2]% chance to grant up to 10 party or raid members mana regeneration equal to 1% of their maximum mana per 5 sec for 15 sec.  This effect cannot occur more often than once every 6 sec.

chilled_to_the_bone.name: Chilled to the Bone
chilled_to_the_bone.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage caused by your Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt, Deep Freeze and Ice Lance spells by [V1]% and reduces the movement speed of all chilled targets by an additional [V2]%.

deep_freeze.name: Deep Freeze
deep_freeze.tooltipTemplate: Stuns the target for 5 seconds.  Only usable on Frozen targets.  Deals 4124 to 4396 damage to monsters permanently immune to stuns.

improved_fire_blast.name: Improved Fire Blast
improved_fire_blast.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by [V1] sec.

incineration.name: Incineration
incineration.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Scorch, Arcane Blast and Cone of Cold spells by [V1]%.

improved_fireball.name: Improved Fireball
improved_fireball.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball spell by [V1] sec.

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.tooltipTemplate: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional [V1]% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

burning_determination.name: Burning Determination
burning_determination.tooltipTemplate: When Interrupted or Silenced you have a [V1]% chance to become immune to the next Interrupt or Silence mechanic.  Lasts 20 sec.

world_in_flames.name: World in Flames
world_in_flames.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike, Pyroblast, Blast Wave, Dragon's Breath, Living Bomb, Blizzard, Arcane Explosion and Arcane Resonance spells by [V1]%.

flame_throwing.name: Flame Throwing
flame_throwing.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of all Fire spells except Frostfire Bolt by [V1] yards.

impact.name: Impact
impact.tooltipTemplate: Gives your damaging spells a [V1]% chance to cause the next Fire Blast you cast to stun the target for 2 sec.

pyroblast.name: Pyroblast
pyroblast.tooltipTemplate: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 176 to 225 Fire damage and an additional 96 Fire damage over 12 sec.

burning_soul.name: Burning Soul
burning_soul.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Fire spells by [V1]% and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by [V2]%.

improved_scorch.name: Improved Scorch
improved_scorch.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to critically hit with Scorch, Fireball and Frostfire Bolt by an additional [V1]% and your damaging Scorch spells have a [V2]% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5% and lasts 30 sec.

molten_shields.name: Molten Shields
molten_shields.tooltipTemplate: Causes your Fire Ward and Frost Ward spells to have a [V1]% chance to reflect the warded spell while active. In addition, your Molten Armor has a [V2]% chance to affect ranged and spell attacks.

master_of_elements.name: Master of Elements
master_of_elements.tooltipTemplate: Your spell criticals will refund [V1]% of their base mana cost.

playing_with_fire.name: Playing with Fire
playing_with_fire.tooltipTemplate: Increases all spell damage caused by [V1]% and all spell damage taken by [V2]%.

critical_mass.name: Critical Mass
critical_mass.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by [V1]%.

blast_wave.name: Blast Wave
blast_wave.tooltipTemplate: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 185 to 217 Fire damage, knocking them back and dazing them for 6 sec.

blazing_speed.name: Blazing Speed
blazing_speed.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a [V1]% chance when hit by a melee attack greater than 5% of your max health to increase your movement speed by 50% and dispel all movement impairing effects.  This effect lasts 6 sec.

fire_power.name: Fire Power
fire_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by [V1]%.

pyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac
pyromaniac.tooltipTemplate: Increases chance to critically hit by [V1]% and allows [V2]% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.

combustion.name: Combustion
combustion.tooltipTemplate: When activated, this spell increases your critical strike damage bonus with Fire damage spells by 50%, and causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%.  This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

molten_fury.name: Molten Fury
molten_fury.tooltipTemplate: Increases damage of all spells against targets with less than 35% health by [V1]%.

fiery_payback.name: Fiery Payback
fiery_payback.tooltipTemplate: When below 35% health all damage taken is reduced by [V1]% and your Pyroblast spell's cast time is reduced by [V2] secs while the cooldown is increased by [V3] secs.  In addition, melee and ranged attacks made against you have a [V4]% chance to disarm your attacker's main hand and ranged weapons.

empowered_fire.name: Empowered Fire
empowered_fire.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt and Pyroblast spells by an amount equal to [V1]% of your spell power.  In addition, each time your Ignite talent causes damage, you have a [V2]% chance to regain 4% of your base mana.

firestarter.name: Firestarter
firestarter.tooltipTemplate: Dealing damage with Blast Wave and Dragon's Breath now has a [V1]% chance to make your next Flamestrike spell instant cast and cost no mana.  Lasts 10 sec.

dragons_breath.name: Dragon's Breath
dragons_breath.tooltipTemplate: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 382 to 442 Fire damage and are Disoriented for 5 sec.  Any direct damaging attack will revive targets.  Turns off your attack when used.

hot_streak.name: Hot Streak
hot_streak.tooltipTemplate: Any time you score 2 non-periodic spell criticals in a row using Fireball, Fire Blast, Scorch, Living Bomb, or Frostfire Bolt, you have a [V1]% chance the next Pyroblast spell cast within 10 sec will be instant cast.

burnout.name: Burnout
burnout.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell critical damage bonus with all spells by [V1]% but your non-periodic spell criticals cost an additional [V2]% of the spell's cost.

living_bomb.name: Living Bomb
living_bomb.tooltipTemplate: The target becomes a Living Bomb, taking 612 Fire damage over 12 sec.  After 12 sec or when the spell is dispelled, the target explodes dealing 306 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yards.

enchants.name: Alter Time
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Alter Time. 
Alter Time: Alter the fabric of time, causing the caster to return to their current location, their health, mana and buffs when cast a second time, or after 4 sec.

Effect negated if the caster dies within before the effect occurs, or moves too far away.

@ext:Does not work with absorb effects.:ext@

enchants.name: Cauterize
enchants.tooltip: An attack which would otherwise kill you will instead bring you to 35% of your maximum health. When this happens all movement speed imparing effects are removed and you gain 50% movement speed for 6 sec, but burn taking 3% of your health as Fire damage every second. This effect can only occur once every minute.

enchants.name: Mass Invisibility
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Mass Invisibility. 
Mass Invisibility: You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 5 sec. The effect is cancelled if you perform any actions. While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible.

enchants.name: Ring of Frost
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Ring of Frost. 
Ring of Frost: Summons a Ring of Frost at the target location. Enemies entering the ring will become frozen for 6 sec. Lasts 8 sec and has an 8 yard radius.

enchants.name: Shimmer
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Shimmer. 
Shimmer: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way.

This ability can be used while casting, but not channeling, and does not trigger a global cooldown.

Shares a cooldown with Blink.

enchants.name: Arcane Cascade
enchants.tooltip:
Your Arcane Blast applies an Arcane Charge on the target and when dealing damage with Arcane Explosion on an affected target the charge triggers, dealing Arcane damage to nearby enemies and restoring 6% base mana.

Subsequent casts on targets with Arcane Charge will apply it to nearby targets.

enchants.name: Arcane Conduit
enchants.tooltip:
Your Evocation channels twice as fast and every second you fire an Arcane Surge, dealing Arcane damage to your target and reduces the cooldown of Arcane Power, Presence of Mind and Evocation by 10 sec.

While channeling you take 40% reduced damage, your Evocation suffers no pushback, and you're immune to Interrupt and Silence effects.

enchants.name: Arcane Dominance
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Arcane Concentration
Increases your spell critical strike rating by 15% of your Intellect.

Using Mana Gem, Presence of Mind or killing an opponent that yields experience or honor you gain Clearcasting.

enchants.name: Biting Frost
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Frostbite
Killing an enemy with Frost damage causes your next spell that can trigger Frostbite to have a 100% chance to trigger it. Triggering Frostbite restores 20% of your base mana.

This effect can only occur once every 5 seconds.

enchants.name: Blink of the Warden
enchants.tooltip:
Your Blink distorts reality around you, leaving behind a mirror image in the place you left for 3 sec. The next spell cast on you will be redirected to the mirror image instead.

In addition, using Blink generates two charges of Arcane Blast.

enchants.name: Brand of the Pyromaniac
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Combustion
After using Combustion your next 2 Pyroblasts will hit up to 2 nearby targets. 

Dealing direct Fire damage reduces the cooldown of Combustion and Cremation by -2 seconds.

enchants.name: Critical Time
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Living Bomb
Your spells now have a 5% increased chance to critically strike your Living Bomb targets.

enchants.name: Draconic Knowledge
enchants.tooltip:
Grants you an effect based on the aspect of your Dragonkin as long as it is active.

Blue and Bronze: Increases your Haste by an amount equal to 12% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect

Red and Green: Increases your Critical Strike Rating by 16% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect

Other: Increases your Spell Power by 16% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect.

enchants.name: Elemental Torrent
enchants.tooltip: When your Water Elemental deals damage with Waterbolt you gain 1% haste for 10 sec, stacking up to 6 times.

enchants.name: Esoteric Power
enchants.tooltip: Arcane Blast can stack up to 5 times. Each stack gives Arcane Blast casts a 10% chance to deal 15% bonus damage to the enemy hit.

enchants.name: Fire Fire Fireball
enchants.tooltip: After casting Fireball 3 times in combat, your next Fireball unleashes an extra Fireball at your target. This damage benefits from Fireball modifiers and can trigger procs.

enchants.name: Fire Walk With Me
enchants.tooltip: Your Flamestrike increases the movement speed of allies who walk through it by 40%. In addition, your Scorch can be cast while moving but its range is reduced by 10 yards.

enchants.name: Fired Up
enchants.tooltip: Dealing direct damage with Fire spells has a 12% chance to cause your next direct damage Fire spell to be a guaranteed critical strike.

enchants.name: Flame Alignment
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Fire Blast restores 15% base mana and grants you an absorb shield equal to 5% of your maximum mana.

The movement speed buff granted by Cauterize lasts for an additional 3 seconds and increases your spell critical strike chance by 0%.

enchants.name: Flame On!
enchants.tooltip: Your Fireball, Scorch, Frostfire Bolt and Pyroblast casts increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast by 33% and reduces its mana cost by 33%, stacking up to 3 times.

enchants.name: Focal Point
enchants.tooltip: The buff you gain from your Focus Magic can now stack up to 3 times.

enchants.name: Frozen Conduit
enchants.tooltip: Casting Frostbolt reduces the mana cost and channel time of your next Blizzard by 20%, stacking up to 3 times.

enchants.name: Frozen Flesh
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Deep Freeze
Requires Brain Freeze
Your Deep Freeze applies Frozen Flesh to your target. If you're dealing damage with Deep Freeze it also triggers Brain Freeze.
Frozen Flesh: Your next 2 Fire spells shatter the target's flesh, dealing ${(330+0)*$<scalingbp>+0*0.4} Frostfire damage. Lasts for 15 sec.

enchants.name: Frozen Haste
enchants.tooltip: Your Frost Bomb explosion increases your spell haste by 10% for 8 sec. The duration is increased by 3 sec for each additional target hit, up to a maximum of 20 sec.

enchants.name: Glacial Cascade
enchants.tooltip:
Reduces the cast time of your Frostbolt by 5%.

Every third Frostbolt triggers a cascade of Frostbolts, hitting 3 additional nearby enemies.

enchants.name: Hailstorm
Icy Slaughter
enchants.tooltip:
Deep Freeze always deals damage when used against monsters (even if they are not stun immune).

Your Icy Veins increases the damage of Cone of Cold and Deep Freeze by 20% and removes their mana cost. 

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor, or dealing damage with Deep Freeze reduces the cooldown of Icy Veins by 10 sec.

enchants.name: Impeccable Timing
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Missile Barrage
Increases your spell haste rating by 10% of your Intellect.

Your mastery of time grants you Impeccable Timing every 10 seconds. While active your next spell that can trigger Missile Barrage, is guaranteed to trigger it.

enchants.name: Infused Gems
enchants.tooltip:
Mana Gem grants 10% spell haste and spell critical strike chance for 15 sec when used.

Newly created Mana Gems have unlimited charges.

enchants.name: Kindling
enchants.tooltip:
Blast Wave no longer knocks back and the critical strike chance of Blast Wave and Dragon's Breath is increased by 10%.

Your Firestarter talent allows you to cast 2 Flamestrikes.

enchants.name: Pendulum
enchants.tooltip: Receive 3% spell haste while above 50% mana and 3% spell critical strike chance while below 50% mana.

enchants.name: Power Overwhelming
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Presence of Mind
Requires Arcane Power
Dealing damage with your Arcane Missiles, Arcane Barrage or Arcane Blast reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Power by and Presence of Mind by 1 second.

enchants.name: Precision Impact
enchants.tooltip:
Your Meteor and Scorch deal 20% increased damage to targets affected by your Fireball or Pyroblast damage over time effect.

Your Fireball and Pyroblast deal 10% more damage to targets affected by your Meteor damage over time effect.

enchants.name: Pushing the Limit
enchants.tooltip: Consuming Brain Freeze, Hot Streak or Missile Barrage increases Haste by 8% for 5 seconds.

enchants.name: Pyroclastic Surprise
enchants.tooltip: Casting Pyroblast while you and your target are not in combat guarantees it to critically hit.

enchants.name: Rapid Blinking
enchants.tooltip:
Your damaging spells with a cast time reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1 seconds.

This effect can only occur once every second and only works against creatures.

enchants.name: Rapid Shatter
enchants.tooltip:
Immediately following up Frostbolt while it is still in the air with any other spell, increases the damage of that spell by 15%.

Spells cast this way do not consume Fingers of Frost.

enchants.name: Resonant Barrage
enchants.tooltip: Your Arcane Barrage makes your next Arcane Blast deal 15% more damage and generate an additional charge, or makes your next Spellsteal steal an additional magic effect. Stacks up to 3.

enchants.name: Scorched Ground
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Living Bomb
When your Living Bomb explodes it scorches the ground, burning enemies within the area for 91.83 Fire damage every second for 8 sec. Also, targets affected by your Living Bomb takes 10% more damage from your Living Bomb explosions.

This effect can only occur once every 8 seconds.

enchants.name: Stay Frosty
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Fingers of Frost
Casting damaging spells increases the chance to trigger your Fingers of Frost talent by an additional 3% until it triggers.

Casting Deep Freeze grants 1 charge of Fingers of Frost.

enchants.name: Transference
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Mindshift
Your intellect is increased by 10% and your spellsteal can now be cast on allies to remove a harmful magic effect.

Your Arcane Blast grants two Arcane Blast stacks

enchants.name: Trisolaris
enchants.tooltip:
The periodic damage of Pyroblast can now stack up to 3 times.

Dealing direct Fire damage to a target afflicted by your Living Bomb has a 20% chance to cause it to spontaneously combust. This does not consume Living Bomb.

enchants.name: Wanding
enchants.tooltip: Wand attacks grant you stacks that increase the cast speed of your next spell by 5%, stacks up to 5 times and lasts 6 sec.

enchants.name: Winter's Blaze
enchants.tooltip:
Consuming Brain Freeze with Frostfire Bolt increases its damage by 15%.

Frostbolt and Ice Lance deal 10% increased damage to targets affected by Frostfire Bolt.

enchants.name: Arcane Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your haste by 4% and increases your Intellect by 8%.

enchants.name: Arcane Orb
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Arcane Orb. 
Arcane Orb: Launches an Arcane Orb forward from your position, traveling up to 35 yards, dealing Arcane damage to enemies it passes through and increasing their Arcane damage taken from you by 10%. Subsequent hits on the same target deals 50% less damage.

enchants.name: Arcane Reverberation
enchants.tooltip:
Your Arcane Echo healing is tripled and costs 25% less mana.

Arcane Power is transformed into Resonating Power.
Resonating Power: Tap into Arcane resources, making your Arcane Echo heal as if you had full mana but cost no mana. 

While active you also gain 2% increased healing done and 2% haste every 2 seconds. Maintaining this buff slowly drains your mana, and will last until your mana drops below 30%, after which it will restore the borrowed mana over 3 seconds before expiring.

enchants.name: Barrage Overload
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Arcane Barrage
Each stack of Arcane Blast empowers your Arcane Barrage to unleash bursts of pure arcane energy over a short duration, dealing ${190*$<scalingbp>+0*0.18} Arcane damage. 

Each Arcane Blast stack consumed by Arcane Barrage grants you a charge of Barrage Overload.

Barrage Overload: Your Arcane Blast casts 20% faster but costs 30% more mana. Your Arcane Missile hits restore 2% mana.

enchants.name: Blazing Flame
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Blazing Speed
Blazing Speed triggers from casting Blast Wave or Dragon's Breath instead of taking damage. In addition, Blazing Speed grants your Scorch and Pyroblast 40% increased critical strike chance and its duration is increased by 2 sec each time those spells are cast.

enchants.name: Cremation
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you Cremation.
Cremation: Deals 1525.58 Fire damage over 10 sec seconds, plus 2 times the total periodic damage from your Ignite, Pyroblast, and Living Bomb effects, which are consumed. This periodic damage can critically strike.

enchants.name: Fire Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your Fire critical strike damage and critical strike chance by 4%.

enchants.name: Frost Bomb
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Frost Bomb. 

Frost Bomb: The target becomes a Frost Bomb, exploding after 8 seconds (4 sec against players) dealing 340.32 Frost damage and slowing enemies within 10 yards by 40% for 2 sec.

Frost damage dealt to the Frost Bomb activates it, dealing an additional 17% damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Casting Frost Bomb on monsters also grants you Fingers of Frost (if known).

enchants.name: Frost Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your Frost damage done by 5% and the damage done by your Water Elemental by 10%.

enchants.name: Frozen Orb
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Frozen Orb. 
Frozen Orb: Launches a Frozen Orb forward from the caster's position, that deals 97.48 Frost damage to all nearby enemy targets for 8 sec. Targets damaged by the Frost Orb are slowed by 40% for 2 sec.

enchants.name: Hot Hands
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Pyroblast
Requires Hot Streak
Pyroblast is also able to trigger Hot Streak.

enchants.name: Ice Barrage
Meteor
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Meteor. 
Meteor: Calls down a meteor which lands at the target location after 3 seconds, dealing 607 to 673 Fire damage, split evenly between all targets within 8 yards, and burns the ground, dealing Fire damage over 6 sec to all enemies in the area.

enchants.name: Rune of Power
Tame Dragonkin
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Tame Dragonkin. 
Tame Dragonkin: Begins taming a dragonkin to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the dragonkin for 20 sec. If you lose the dragonkin's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Each type of dragonkin has unique abilities that you will be able to make use of.

enchants.name: Touch of the Magi
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Touch of the Magi. 
Touch of the Magi: Applies Touch of the Magi to the enemy, accumulating 50% of the Arcane damage you deal to the target for 10 sec, and then explodes restoring 20% total mana and dealing the accumulated Arcane damage to the target and nearby enemies.

enchants.name: Wacky Wizardry
enchants.tooltip: Your damaging Mage spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Mage spell for free.

enchants.name: Abjurer's Ward: Arcane
enchants.tooltip: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of Presence of Mind by 10 seconds.

enchants.name: Abjurer's Ward: Fire
enchants.tooltip: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of your Combustion by 10 seconds.

enchants.name: Abjurer's Ward: Frost
enchants.tooltip: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of Cold Snap by 10 seconds.

enchants.name: Arcane Concentration
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Arcane Concentration Talent.

enchants.name: Arcane Focus
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to hit and reduces the mana cost of your Arcane spells by 3%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Arcane Focus Talent.

enchants.name: Arcane Fortitude
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your armor by an amount equal to 150% of your Intellect.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Arcane Fortitude Talent.

enchants.name: Arcane Meditation
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Arcane Meditation Talent.

enchants.name: Arcane Power Well
enchants.tooltip: Casting damaging Arcane spells has a 15% chance to make your next non-Arcane spell have no cost.

enchants.name: Arcane Shielding
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Decreases the mana lost per point of damage taken when Mana Shield is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by Mage Armor by 50%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Arcane Shielding Talent.

enchants.name: Arcane Stability
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting any Arcane spell by 100%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Arcane Stability Talent.

enchants.name: Arcane Subtlety
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by 30% and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 40%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Arcane Subtlety Talent.

enchants.name: Arctic Power Well
enchants.tooltip: Casting damaging Frost spells has a 15% chance to make your next non-Frost spell have no cost.

enchants.name: Arctic Reach
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, Deep Freeze and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Arctic Reach Talent.

enchants.name: Burning Soul
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Fire spells by 70% and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Burning Soul Talent.

enchants.name: Fiery Power Well
enchants.tooltip: Casting damaging Fire spells has a 15% chance to make your next non-Fire spell within 10 sec have no cost.

enchants.name: Flame Throwing
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of all Fire spells except Frostfire Bolt by 6 yards.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Flame Throwing Talent.

enchants.name: Focus Magic
Frost Channeling
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost of all spells by 10% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Frost Channeling Talent.

enchants.name: Frost Warding
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the armor and resistances given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 50%.  In addition, gives your Frost Ward and Fire Ward a 30% chance to negate the warded damage spell and restore mana equal to the damage caused.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Frost Warding Talent.

enchants.name: Frostbite
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to freeze the target for 5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Frostbite Talent.

enchants.name: Glyph of Arcane Barrage
enchants.tooltip: Arcane Barrage now restores 5% of your missing mana.

enchants.name: Glyph of Arcane Blast
enchants.tooltip: Each stack of the Arcane Blast buff reduces the cast time of Arcane Blast by 4%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Arcane Explosion
enchants.tooltip: Reduces mana cost of Arcane Explosion by 10%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Arcane Missiles
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of Arcane Missiles and Arcane Barrage by 25%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Arcane Power
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Arcane Power by 3 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Blast Wave
enchants.tooltip: The mana cost of your Blast Wave spell is reduced by 15%, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

enchants.name: Glyph of Blink
enchants.tooltip: Increases the distance you travel with the Blink spell by 5 yards.

enchants.name: Glyph of Deep Freeze
enchants.tooltip: Increases the range of Deep Freeze by 10 yards.

enchants.name: Glyph of Eternal Water
enchants.tooltip: Your Summon Water Elemental now lasts indefinitely, but your Water Elemental can no longer cast Freeze.

enchants.name: Glyph of Evocation
enchants.tooltip: Your Evocation ability also causes you to regain 60% of your health over its duration.

enchants.name: Glyph of Fire Blast
enchants.tooltip: Guarantees the critical strike of Fire Blast on stunned or incapacitated targets.

enchants.name: Glyph of Fireball
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball spell by 5%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Frost Nova
enchants.tooltip: Your Frost Nova targets can take an additional 20% damage before the Frost Nova effect automatically breaks.

enchants.name: Glyph of Frostbolt
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage dealt by Frostbolt by 10%, but removes the slowing effect.

enchants.name: Glyph of Frostfire
enchants.tooltip: Increases the initial damage dealt by Frostfire Bolt by 3% and its critical strike chance by 3%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Ice Armor
enchants.tooltip: Your Ice Armor and Frost Armor spells grant an additional 50% armor and resistance.

enchants.name: Glyph of Ice Barrier
enchants.tooltip: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your Ice Barrier by 30%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Ice Block
enchants.tooltip: Your Frost Nova cooldown is now reset every time you use Ice Block.

enchants.name: Glyph of Ice Lance
enchants.tooltip: Your Ice Lance now causes 5 times damage against frozen targets higher level than you instead of triple damage.

enchants.name: Glyph of Icy Veins
enchants.tooltip: Your Icy Veins ability also removes all movement slowing and cast time slowing effects.

enchants.name: Glyph of Invisibility
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of the Invisibility effect by 10 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Living Bomb
enchants.tooltip: The periodic damage from your Living Bomb can now be critical strikes.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mage Armor
enchants.tooltip: Your Mage Armor regenerates 2% of your maximum mana every 5 seconds but no longer grants you mana regeneration while casting.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mana Gem
enchants.tooltip: Increases the mana received from using a mana gem by 40%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mending Images
enchants.tooltip: While you are under the effect of Mindshift, your Mirror Images cast Arcane Mending on injured nearby allies every 2 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mirror Image
enchants.tooltip: Your Mirror Image spell now lasts for 60 seconds and creates a 4th copy.

enchants.name: Glyph of Molten Armor
enchants.tooltip: Your Molten Armor grants an additional 20% of your spirit as critical strike rating.

enchants.name: Glyph of Polymorph
enchants.tooltip: Your Polymorph spell also removes all damage over time effects from the target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Remove Curse
enchants.tooltip: Your Remove Curse spell also makes the target immune to all curses for 4 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Scorch
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage of your Scorch spell by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Water Elemental
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of your Summon Water Elemental spell by -30 sec.

enchants.name: Ice Floes
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Ice Block and Icy Veins spells by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Ice Floes Talent.

enchants.name: Ice Shards
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Ice Shards Talent.

enchants.name: Icy Veins
Ignite
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Ignite Talent.

enchants.name: Impact
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives your damaging spells a 10% chance to cause the next Fire Blast you cast to stun the target for 2 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Impact Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Blizzard
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Adds a chill effect to your Blizzard spell.  This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 50%.  Lasts 1.5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Blizzard Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Counterspell
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Your Counterspell also silences the target for 4 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Counterspell Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Fire Blast
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Fire Blast Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Fireball
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the casting time of your Fireball spell by 0.5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Fireball Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Frostbolt
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Frostbolt Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Scorch
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to critically hit with Scorch, Fireball and Frostfire Bolt by an additional 3% and your damaging Scorch spells have a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5% and lasts 30 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Scorch Talent.

enchants.name: Incineration
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Scorch, Arcane Blast and Cone of Cold spells by 9%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Incineration Talent.

enchants.name: Magic Absorption
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases all resistances by 1 per level and causes all spells that damage you have a 10% chance to restore 2% of your total mana. 6 second cooldown

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Magic Absorption Talent.

enchants.name: Magic Attunement
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards and the effect of your Amplify Magic and Dampen Magic spells by 2%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Magic Attunement Talent.

enchants.name: Master of Elements
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Your spell criticals will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Master of Elements Talent.

enchants.name: Permafrost
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 3 secs, reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%, and reduces the target's healing received by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Permafrost Talent.

enchants.name: Piercing Ice
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Piercing Ice Talent.

enchants.name: Precision
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost and increases your chance to hit with spells by 3%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Precision Talent.

enchants.name: Pyroblast
Shatter
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against frozen targets by 50%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Shatter Talent.

enchants.name: Spell Impact
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage of your Arcane Explosion, Arcane Blast, Blast Wave, Fire Blast, Scorch, Fireball, Ice Lance and Cone of Cold spells by an additional 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Spell Impact Talent.

enchants.name: Torment the Weak
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Your Frostbolt, Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Pyroblast, Arcane Missiles, Arcane Blast, and Arcane Barrage abilities deal 12% more damage to snared or slowed targets.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Torment the Weak Talent.

enchants.name: World in Flames
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike, Pyroblast, Blast Wave, Dragon's Breath, Living Bomb, Blizzard, Arcane Explosion and Arcane Resonance spells by 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the World in Flames Talent.

abilities.name: Amplify Magic
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 75 and healing spells by up to 80.  Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Arcane Barrage
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Launches several missiles at the enemy target, causing 500 to 609 Arcane damage.

abilities.name: Arcane Barrier
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Consumes your Arcane Blast stacks to instantly heal a friendly target for 463 and surround them with an Arcane barrier for 4 seconds per stack.

The shield absorbs up to 30% of physical damage taken, up to an amount equal to 10% of your max mana. Each point of damage absorbed costs 0.1 mana.

abilities.name: Arcane Blast
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 719 to 822 Arcane damage.  Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of your Arcane spells is increased by 15% and mana cost of Arcane Blast increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 12 sec or until any Arcane damage spell except Arcane Blast is cast.

abilities.name: Arcane Explosion
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 284 to 307 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Arcane Intellect
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases the target's Intellect by 31 for 30 min.

abilities.name: Arcane Missiles
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 222 Arcane damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Arcane Power
abilities.tooltipTemplate: When activated, your spells deal 20% more damage and healing while costing 20% more mana to cast.  This effect lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way.  Also frees the caster from stuns and bonds.

abilities.name: Conjure Food
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Conjures 10 cinnamon rolls, providing the mage and his allies with something to eat.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Conjure Mana Gem
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Conjures a mana ruby that can be used to instantly restore 1448 to 1521 mana.

abilities.name: Conjure Refreshment
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Conjures 20 Mana Pies providing the mage and his allies with something to eat.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Conjure Water
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Conjures 10 bottles of crystal water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Counterspell
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 8 sec.  Generates a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Dampen Magic
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Dampens magic used against the targeted party member.
Reduces all spell damage taken by 5% and reduces all healing taken by 5%.

abilities.name: Evocation
abilities.tooltipTemplate: While channeling this spell, you gain 60% of your total mana over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Focus Magic
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases the target's chance to critically hit with spells by 3%.  When the target critically hits the caster's chance to critically hit with spells is increased by 3% for 10 sec.  Cannot be cast on self.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Fades the caster to invisibility over 3 sec, reducing threat each second.  The effect is cancelled if you perform any actions.  While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible.  Lasts 20 sec.

abilities.name: Mage Armor
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases your resistance to all magic by 15 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.  In addition, the duration of all harmful Magic effects used against you is reduced by 50%.  Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time.  Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Absorbs 570 damage, draining mana instead.  Drains 1.5 mana per damage absorbed.  Lasts 1 min.

abilities.name: Mindshift
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
You shift into an Arcane dimension increasing your healing by 50% and reduces your damage by 50%.

Enables the use of Arcane Mending and Arcane Resonance.

While shifted your spells cannot miss and your hit rating is converted into Intellect.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Creates 3 copies of the caster nearby, which cast spells and attack the mage's enemies.  Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Polymorph
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec.  While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly.  Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form.  Only one target can be polymorphed at a time.  Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

abilities.name: Presence of Mind
abilities.tooltipTemplate: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

abilities.name: Remove Curse
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Removes 1 Curse from a friendly target.

abilities.name: Ritual of Refreshment
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Begins a ritual that creates a refreshment table.  Raid members can click the table to acquire Conjured Mana Biscuits.  The tables lasts for 3 min or 50 charges.  Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual.  In order to participate, all players must right-click the refreshment portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

abilities.name: Slow
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Reduces target's movement speed by 60%, increases the time between ranged attacks by 60% and increases casting time by 30%.  Lasts 15 sec.  Slow can only affect one target at a time.

abilities.name: Slow Fall
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Slows friendly party or raid target's falling speed for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Spellsteal
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target.  This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.

abilities.name: Touch of the Magi
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Applies Touch of the Magi to the enemy, accumulating 50% of the Arcane damage you deal to the target for 10 sec, and then explodes restoring 20% total mana and dealing the accumulated Arcane damage to the target and nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 185 to 217 Fire damage, knocking them back and dazing them for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.tooltipTemplate: When activated, this spell increases your critical strike damage bonus with Fire damage spells by 50%, and causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%.  This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

abilities.name: Cremation
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Deals 1525.58 Fire damage over 10 sec seconds, plus 2 times the total periodic damage from your Ignite, Pyroblast, and Living Bomb effects, which are consumed. This periodic damage can critically strike.

abilities.name: Dragon's Breath
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 382 to 442 Fire damage and are Disoriented for 5 sec.  Any direct damaging attack will revive targets.  Turns off your attack when used.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Blasts the enemy for 512 to 602 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Ward
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Absorbs 875 Fire damage.  Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 626 to 790 Fire damage and an additional 60 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Flamestrike
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 381 to 465 Fire damage and an additional 340 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Living Bomb
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The target becomes a Living Bomb, taking 612 Fire damage over 12 sec.  After 12 sec or when the spell is dispelled, the target explodes dealing 306 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Molten Armor
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes 75 Fire damage when hit, increases your critical strike rating by 30% of your Spirit, and reduces the chance you are critically hit by 5%.  Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time.  Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Pyroblast
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 176 to 225 Fire damage and an additional 96 Fire damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Scorch the enemy for 237 to 279 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Scorch (Scorched Earth)
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Scorch the enemy for 366 to 416 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 1696 Frost damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.tooltipTemplate: When activated, this spell finishes the cooldown on all Frost spells you recently cast.

abilities.name: Cone of Cold
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 337 to 367 Frost damage and are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Deep Freeze
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Stuns the target for 5 seconds.  Only usable on Frozen targets.  Deals 4124 to 4396 damage to monsters permanently immune to stuns.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases Armor by 200.  If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec.  Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time.  Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Blasts enemies near the caster for 72 to 82 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Frost Ward
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Absorbs 875 Frost damage.  Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 578 to 620 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 9 sec.

abilities.name: Frostfire Bolt
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 457 to 549 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 90 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists.

abilities.name: Ice Age
Ice Barrier
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly shields you, absorbing 497 damage.  Lasts 1 min.  While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be delayed by damage.

abilities.name: Ice Block
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move or cast spells.  Also causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Ice Lance
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Deals 146 to 170 Frost damage to an enemy target.  Causes triple damage against Frozen targets.

abilities.name: Icy Veins
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Hastens your spellcasting, increasing spell casting speed by 20% and reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 100%.  Lasts 20 sec.

abilities.name: Summon Water Elemental
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summon a Water Elemental to fight for the caster?(s70937)[][ for 45 sec].
